kernel_recipe.selection: whole screened gene catalog, no significance or LR selection
kernel_recipe.model: gene-local exact unstranded single-read matching, uniform RH starts and uniform DT terminal-window starts
kernel_recipe.background: fixed compatibility-uniform per-transcript component with unchanged DT/RH sequence capture exposures, not an estimated sequencing-error rate
kernel_recipe.limitations: not the real aligner or compound-UMI EC construction; omits other-gene mapping, empirical primer bias and genomic variants; shorter seed-length control is not full-read alignment
kernel_recipe.inference: opportunity/support and fixed-map KL diagnostics only, not a DS test, full-family benchmark or replication improvement

control.count_objects: original unmodified count matrices, metadata, gene structures and transcript ordering
control.support: every global CSR index/indptr and every positive source compatibility preserved
control.interpretation: experimental exact gene-local single-read opportunity maps with fixed background, not real aligner/UMI or validated sampling law

family: complete split arrays, failed subject fits retained at p1; fixed published matched gene-pair split universes
scope: split-only assessment; no full-data or LR claim
null_limitation: independent event sign flips are training calibration, not an actual biological count-null validation
